extra.description: Deduct from the caller's Telegraph escrow balance at the next epoch close. Fund it once with EscrowFacet.depositUSDC(amount); no per-request settlement.

findings: withdraw updates balances[msg.sender] after the external call → re‑entrancy vulnerability.
No check that msg.sender actually has a non‑zero balance; calling withdraw with zero balance still performs a call.
setOwner is unrestricted; anyone can change the contract owner, breaking access control.
owner is declared after setOwner; while Solidity allows it, it's clearer to declare state variables before functions.
No receive/fallback function; direct ether transfers to the contract will be rejected
